data.name: Deck Casters
data.detailed_description:
Deck Casters combina os mundos dos videogames de Deck-Building, RTS e MOBA.
Nós criamos uma experiência nova e nunca antes vista para os fãs desses gêneros se juntarem e combaterem.

Em Deck Casters, os jogadores são magos arcanos que criam poderosos decks de batalha para travarem duelos de 1v1 ou 2v2 com outros jogadores (multiplayer) entre 2 mapas diferentes.
Desde fortalecer pontos estratégicos do mapa até usar exércitos e feitiços no momento certo - é tudo sobre a construção de um excelente Deck e destruir seus oponentes em pedacinhos.

Pertencendo a um dos cinco Elementos - Light, Dark, Water, Fire e Earth - as criaturas e feitiços de ArmaGallant vêm com suas próprias forças e distintivos estilos de jogo. Fique em um ou misture e combine seus favoritos para criar combos de cartas devastadores.

Então, vá em frente, puxe as suas cartas, lance seu deck e prepare-se para o Deck Casters!

CARACTERÍSTICAS PRINCIPAIS

• Novo Estilo de Jogo - Deck Casters combina os elementos de jogabilidade tática e estratégica dos videogames de Deck-Building, RTS e MOBA.

• Conheça os 5 Elementos - Conheça as criaturas e os feitiços poderosos dos Cinco Elementos – Light, Dark , Water, Fire e Earth.

• Construa o seu Melhor Deck de Batalha - Selecione um Campeão e comece a criar seu baralho de batalha principal. Aprenda, evolua e domine as várias combinações para criar um Deck digno dos Elementos.

• Execute suas Estratégias em Tempo Real - jogue suas cartas nos nossos dinâmicos campos de batalha de RTS. Compete com jogadores online ou teste suas táticas de batalha contra a IA.

• Reuna seus Amigos - Participe em emocionantes combates online de 1v1 ou 2v2 em Deck Casters. Junte-se com amigos para criar decks sinérgicos ou escala os Ranks em Solo player para ser o melhor Jogador de deckcaster!

reviews.review:
I was genuinely hopeful for Deck Casters. A combination of deck-building, RTS, and MOBA sounded like a good concept. The fact that the console version of this game was somewhat successful as well, particularly for a small studio, added further to my interest in the game.

I have tried my utmost to get this game running at an optimum level on my rig (i5-4690K, 16GB RAM, Nvidia 980 running Windows 10) which is far and away better than the minimum specs. I was planning to do a gameplay video of the game. I have all of the latest drivers, etc. for my hardware. Unfortunately, the game runs extremely poorly regardless of whatever I try to do with it.

I posted my concern with the game's optimisation on the discussion boards here on Steam. Others have asked questions of the developers as well. Sadly, the level of commitment to communication with the potential buyers of the game has been well below par. To put it simply, they have only responded to one comment. It was in regards to the differences between the console and PC ports as they have different names. As [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_sgTz4zWsUA]Maghook Gaming[/url] discovered this version of the game has fewer features than the console version. Make sure you read and upvote his review as it features quite a bit of research.

Additionally, there has been no launch discount that has been applied to the game which has become standard. This is especially the case for largely multiplayer dependent games from indie developers. The US$16.99 price for the game is a prohibitive barrier of entry for a studio releasing their first game on Steam. I argue that this is especially the case given the recent winter sale.

Insofar as this is a single player game, its only intention is to teach the players the fundamentals of gameplay so that you are prepared for the multiplayer. Again, it does a poor job. The actual in-game tutorial is nothing more than a few screens of information. It doesn't teach players new to the genre what they're supposed to do. The actual singleplayer game mode essentially forces the player to learn the game for themselves. It is far too vague and not intuitive for beginners.

Unless the developers have a change of attitude, begin making themselves available on the discussion forums, and actually show that they care about their game and its potential player base, you can almost consider this one to be dead on arrival.

Unfortunately, I cannot possibly give this game a thumbs up in its current predicament. Should things change I'll be more than happy to revisit my review and make the changes reflective of the game in its (and its community's) state at that time.
